entry.title: New: Resolution 519 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT OF LEONG KUNIHIRO BROOKE AND KIM, AS SPECIAL COUNSEL TO REPRESENT THE COUNTY OF HAWAI‘I, DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES, WORKERS’ COMPENSATION DIVISION

Extends the retention of Special Counsel Services with additional compensation of $300,000 and total compensation not to exceed $600,000.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 519-24 & GOEAC-138 - 06/05/24
